title: JDS Human Resource Development Scholarship
description:
Japanese government scholarships for young government officials from partner countries to take a two-year English-taught master’s (and some doctorates) in Japan.

  • Tuition
  • Living allowance
  • Travel to and from Japan

Eligibility: Mainly young government officials from JDS countries such as Bangladesh, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, the Maldives, Kenya, Mozambique and Senegal. Eligibility differs by country.

How to apply: Each country has its own call; Bangladesh is recruiting for 2027-28 with screening from January 2027. Check your country page for the exact deadline.

title: JICA ABE Initiative
description:
The African Business Education Initiative: a master’s at a Japanese university plus an internship at a Japanese company, for young Africans.

  • Master’s tuition
  • Living allowance
  • Travel
  • Internship at a Japanese company

Eligibility: Citizens of any of the 54 African countries, under 40, with a bachelor’s degree (TOEFL iBT 80 / IELTS 6.5 or equivalent). Applicants generally need a current job or affiliation.

How to apply: Apply through the JICA office in your country; recent calls have closed around September-October. The 2027 dates are an estimate.

title: JASSO Monbukagakusho Honors Scholarship
description:
A monthly scholarship for privately financed international students at Japanese universities.

  • JPY 48,000 per month for undergraduate and graduate students
  • Usually paid for one year

Eligibility: Privately financed international students with student visa status whose monthly remittances are under JPY 90,000. Top EJU scorers can be reserved before arrival.

How to apply: Apply through your Japanese university; schools set their own internal deadlines.

title: Honjo International Scholarship (Foreign Students)
description:
One of Japan’s most generous private scholarships for international graduate students.

  • JPY 230,000 per month for 1-2 year degrees
  • JPY 210,000 (3-year) or JPY 180,000 (longer degrees)
  • No repayment

Eligibility: Foreign students enrolled in or applying to a Japanese graduate school; interviews are in Japanese. About 10 awards a year.

How to apply: The 2027 round closes 31 October 2026; the next window is September-October 2027.

title: APU Tuition Reduction Scholarship
description:
Tuition reductions for international students at APU, a bilingual university with students from over 100 countries.

  • 30%, 50%, 65%, 80% or 100% tuition reduction for the minimum study period

Eligibility: International applicants who will hold a student visa; decided before enrolment based on academic ability and financial need.

How to apply: Awarded with admission across several rounds; you cannot apply after enrolling.

title: Ewha Global Partnership Program (EGPP)
description:
Full scholarships for women from developing countries with leadership potential at Ewha, the world’s largest women’s university.

  • Full tuition and entrance fee
  • Dormitory housing
  • Living stipend
  • Airfare and insurance

Eligibility: Women from developing countries admitted through international admission; graduate recipients keep a 3.5 GPA.

How to apply: Graduate recipients are chosen from the regular admission pool; check Ewha’s admission calendar.

title: KOICA Scholarship Program
description:
Fully funded master’s programmes in Korea for public officials from developing countries.

  • Tuition
  • Airfare
  • Housing and meals
  • Medical insurance

Eligibility: Mostly government officials nominated through official channels in KOICA partner countries; English proficiency required.

How to apply: Calls are announced by KOICA country offices; dates differ by country.

title: UNIST Graduate Scholarship for International Students
provider: Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology
description:
Full tuition and stipends for international graduate students in UNIST research labs.

  • Full tuition
  • At least KRW 17.28 million a year (master’s) or KRW 20.88 million (PhD)

Eligibility: International applicants admitted under the UNIST Scholarship tier with a supporting adviser.

How to apply: UNIST runs spring and fall admission rounds; check the current guidelines.

title: POSTECH Graduate Teaching and Research Assistantships
provider: Pohang University of Science and Technology
description:
Funded graduate study at one of Korea’s top science and technology universities.

  • Monthly TA/RA support of KRW 1,850,000 (master’s) or KRW 2,200,000 (PhD) including tuition
  • Settlement allowance for new arrivals
  • Ruth L. Satter award for Asian women

Eligibility: International students admitted to POSTECH graduate programmes; amounts can vary by lab.

How to apply: Check the graduate admissions calendar for spring and fall rounds.

title: Yonsei Underwood International College Scholarship
description:
Full-tuition scholarships for newly admitted international students at Yonsei’s English-taught liberal arts college.

  • Full tuition for 4 years

Eligibility: Newly admitted international students to UIC, selected on academic credentials.

How to apply: Considered automatically with admission; check UIC’s admission dates.

title: GIST International Graduate Scholarship
provider: Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology
description:
Every international graduate student at GIST receives a scholarship without a separate application.

  • 100% tuition
  • Monthly stipends and allowances
  • Research assistantship pay (about KRW 6.4M/yr MS, 13.7M/yr PhD on average)
  • One-way flight for first entry

Eligibility: All admitted international graduate students.

How to apply: Apply through GIST graduate admissions (spring and fall rounds).

title: SKKU International Undergraduate Scholarships
description:
Admission scholarships for international undergraduates, including the Samsung Global Sungkyun Scholarship.

  • 10% to 100% of dues, decided at admission
  • Samsung Global Sungkyun Scholarship: full dues for 4 years plus living stipend
  • SKKU Global Leader: 50% for 4 years

Eligibility: International undergraduate applicants; English or Korean language test scores can earn additional waivers.

How to apply: Selected automatically from admission results.

title: Friedrich Naumann Foundation Scholarships for Non-EU Students
description:
Federal Foreign Office-funded scholarships for liberal-minded students from non-EU countries in Germany.

  • Monthly scholarship (about EUR 934 master’s, up to EUR 1,350 PhD)
  • EUR 300 study-cost lump sum
  • No repayment

Eligibility: Non-EU master’s students with at least two semesters left, or doctoral candidates, at German universities.

How to apply: Two windows a year: 1-30 April and 1-31 October.

title: Friedrich-Ebert-Stiftung Scholarships for International Students
description:
Up to 40 scholarships a year for socially engaged students from Africa, Asia, Latin America and Eastern Europe in Germany.

  • EUR 992 per month
  • Health insurance
  • Family allowance where applicable

Eligibility: International students already enrolled at a German university, with C1 German; applications in German.

How to apply: Master’s applicants: by 30 November (winter semester) or 31 May (summer semester).

title: Rosa Luxemburg Foundation Scholarships for International Students
description:
Living stipends for international master’s and PhD students in Germany with social or political engagement.

  • Monthly living stipend
  • Seminars and support

Eligibility: Foreign nationals with a bachelor’s (master’s) or admission to a German doctorate, B2 German, and documented engagement.

How to apply: Deadline 1 October each year, with funding from 1 April.

title: Hanns Seidel Foundation Scholarships for Foreign Students
description:
Scholarships for master’s and doctoral study in Germany for students committed to democracy and civil society.

  • Up to EUR 992 per month (master’s) or EUR 1,300 (PhD)
  • 12 to 36 months

Eligibility: Above-average graduates with B2 German, voluntary engagement, and admission (master’s) or a supervisor (PhD) in Germany.

How to apply: Apply through your country’s HSF office or online; selection rounds are held in February and August.

title: DAAD Bi-nationally Supervised Doctoral Degrees (Cotutelle)
description:
Funding for doctoral candidates doing a joint or sandwich PhD between their home university and a German university.

  • EUR 1,400 per month while in Germany
  • EUR 460 research allowance
  • Insurance and travel allowance
  • 7 to 24 months

Eligibility: Doctoral candidates admitted to a programme with joint supervision in Germany and at home.

How to apply: Deadlines depend on your country; check the DAAD database.

title: Max Planck Research Schools (IMPRS) PhD Positions
description:
Salaried PhD positions at the International Max Planck Research Schools across Germany.

  • Employment contract at 65-75% of TVöD E13 (from about EUR 2,700 gross per month)
  • 3 years, extendable by 1

Eligibility: Graduates of any nationality with a strong master’s (or bachelor’s for some schools). Apply only through official school websites.

How to apply: Each school sets its own deadline; many close on 1 December for an autumn start.

title: DAAD Study Scholarships — Postgraduate Studies in Music
description:
DAAD scholarships for musicians to take a master’s or postgraduate study at a German state college of music.

  • EUR 992 per month
  • Insurance and travel allowance

Eligibility: Graduates in music whose first degree is no more than six years old; audio or video recordings required.

How to apply: The last deadline was in September 2026 for funding from October 2027.

title: DAAD Study Scholarships — Postgraduate Studies in Architecture
description:
Scholarships for architecture, interior, urban and landscape design graduates to study in Germany.

  • EUR 992 per month
  • Insurance and travel allowance

Eligibility: Graduates in architecture and related fields applying to a master’s at a German university.

How to apply: Check the DAAD database for your country’s deadline.

title: CAS-ANSO Scholarship (Degree Programme)
description:
Scholarships for students from developing countries to take science degrees at the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences and USTC.

  • Tuition waiver
  • Master’s: CNY 3,000 per month
  • PhD: CNY 6,000-7,000 per month

Eligibility: International applicants, mainly from developing countries in the ANSO network.

How to apply: The call normally opens mid-October; the last deadline was 31 January.

title: ANSO-CAS-TWAS/UNESCO PhD Scholarship
description:
Hundreds of PhD scholarships a year for scientists from developing countries at Chinese Academy of Sciences institutes.

  • CNY 6,000-7,000 per month for up to 48 months
  • Tuition waiver
  • Health insurance
  • Travel and visa costs

Eligibility: Permanent residents of a developing country other than China with a master’s or equivalent, within the age limit.

How to apply: Usually announced alongside the CAS-ANSO call; check TWAS for exact dates.

title: International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship
provider: Center for Language Education and Cooperation (CLEC)
description:
Chinese government scholarships for future Chinese language teachers to study in China.

  • Tuition and accommodation
  • Master’s in International Chinese Language Education: RMB 3,000 per month
  • One-year study programme: RMB 2,500 per month

Eligibility: Non-Chinese nationals meeting HSK/HSKK requirements; often recommended by a Confucius Institute.

How to apply: Applications usually run in spring; check the current CLEC guidelines.

title: Bilkent University Graduate Scholarships
description:
Almost all graduate students in Bilkent’s engineering and sciences programmes receive full tuition waivers and stipends.

  • Full tuition waiver
  • 12-month stipend up to 3x (PhD) or 2x (MS) the monthly living cost on campus

Eligibility: International applicants to Bilkent master’s and PhD programmes; departments set their own criteria.

How to apply: The fall admission and scholarship deadline was 1 June in 2026.

title: Koç University Graduate Fellowships
description:
Graduate fellowships at one of Turkey’s leading private research universities.

  • Full tuition
  • Monthly stipend (about TL 60,000 PhD / TL 39,000 MS from October 2026)
  • Housing or housing allowance
  • Health insurance

Eligibility: Admitted thesis-based master’s and PhD students; all admitted PhD students receive a full scholarship.

How to apply: Deadlines are set by each graduate school; check the current calendar.

title: Sabancı University International Undergraduate Scholarships
description:
Merit tuition waivers for international undergraduates at Sabancı University in Istanbul.

  • 25% to 100% tuition waiver (tuition is about USD 36,500 a year)
  • Dormitory scholarships available

Eligibility: All eligible international applicants are considered automatically.

How to apply: Awarded through the international admission rounds.

title: King Saud University PhD Initiative
description:
Fully funded PhD places at King Saud University in Riyadh for talented students from Saudi Arabia and abroad.

  • Full tuition
  • Living allowance of about SAR 54,000 (USD 14,400) a year
  • On-campus housing
  • Health care and relocation support

Eligibility: Full-time PhD applicants with TOEFL iBT 61 / IELTS 6 or equivalent.

How to apply: Check the initiative site for the current intake.

title: Islamic University of Madinah Scholarships
description:
Saudi government-funded bachelor’s scholarships for international students at the Islamic University of Madinah.

  • Free tuition
  • Monthly allowance
  • Furnished housing
  • Flights and health care

Eligibility: International students living outside Saudi Arabia; Arabic study is provided if needed. Postgraduate places are for IU graduates.

How to apply: Application windows change each year and are announced on the university portal.

title: Universiti Malaya Bright Scholarship
description:
A prestigious full scholarship for outstanding local and international PhD by research candidates.

  • Full PhD scholarship (tuition and stipend)

Eligibility: Outstanding candidates admitted to a UM PhD by research.

How to apply: Cycles close at the end of April (October intake) and end of September (February intake).

title: Mahidol Postgraduate Scholarships for International Students
description:
University-wide scholarships for international master’s and doctoral students at Thailand’s leading health and science university.

  • Tuition fees and additional expenses (varies by award)

Eligibility: International students eligible to enrol in a Mahidol master’s or doctoral programme.

How to apply: Check the Faculty of Graduate Studies for the current round.

title: Mahidol Living Allowance Scholarship for Foreign Graduate Students
description:
A monthly living allowance for graduate students from ASEAN, South Asia, Central Asia and Africa at Mahidol.

  • Up to THB 8,000 per month

Eligibility: Registered graduate students from eligible regions who have paid their tuition.

How to apply: Announced by Mahidol’s international relations office each year.

title: P.E.O. International Peace Scholarship
description:
Need-based scholarships for women from outside the US and Canada pursuing graduate study there.

  • Up to USD 12,500 for one year
  • One renewal possible

Eligibility: Women who are not US or Canadian citizens or residents, enrolled full time in a graduate programme in the US or Canada.

How to apply: Eligibility forms are due 15 December 2026; full applications by 1 February or 15 March 2027.

title: Margaret McNamara Education Grants
description:
Grants for women from developing countries studying at universities in the US, Canada, South Africa and Latin America.

  • One-year education grants (amount varies by programme)
  • Community and mentoring

Eligibility: Women from developing countries, usually aged 25 or older, with financial need and full-time enrolment.

How to apply: Each programme has its own window, e.g. South Africa from 15 May to 14 September.

title: Amherst College Financial Aid for International Students
description:
Amherst is need-blind for international applicants and meets 100% of calculated need without loans.

  • Need-based grants (average international award over USD 84,000)
  • No loans packaged

Eligibility: International first-year and transfer applicants; CSS Profile required.

How to apply: Regular decision deadline in early January.

title: Bowdoin College Financial Aid for International Students
description:
Bowdoin is need-blind for international first-year applicants and meets full need with grants.

  • Grants meeting full calculated need
  • No loans since 2008

Eligibility: International first-year applicants without a prior bachelor’s degree (transfers are not eligible for aid).

How to apply: Regular decision deadline in early January.

title: Brown University Financial Aid for International Students
description:
Brown is need-blind for first-year international applicants and meets 100% of demonstrated need.

  • Need-based scholarships
  • Advancing Africa Scholarship automatically considered for Sub-Saharan African citizens

Eligibility: First-year international applicants who request aid when applying; CSS Profile required.

How to apply: Regular decision deadline in early January.

title: Columbia University Financial Aid for International Students
description:
Columbia meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted international students for all four years, without loans.

  • Grants and work-study (average award about USD 79,000)

Eligibility: International applicants who request aid on their application (admission is need-aware).

How to apply: Regular decision deadline: 1 January 2027.

title: Berea College Full Funding for International Students
description:
Berea covers 100% of tuition, housing, food and fees for every international student it admits.

  • Full tuition, housing, food and fees
  • Paid on-campus job
  • No loans

Eligibility: International applicants (about 40 are admitted each year); a USD 2,200 deposit is required, with help available.

How to apply: Check Berea’s international admissions page for the current deadline.

title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars at UC Berkeley
description:
Full scholarships for master’s students from Sub-Saharan Africa at UC Berkeley.

  • Full financial support
  • Academic, social and career support

Eligibility: African citizens applying to a Berkeley master’s; priority to those with an African undergraduate degree.

How to apply: Deadlines follow each master’s programme’s admission deadline (mostly December-January).

title: Trinity College Dublin Global Excellence Postgraduate Scholarship
description:
Tuition reductions for non-EU students on postgraduate taught programmes at Trinity.

  • EUR 2,000 to EUR 5,000 one-time tuition reduction

Eligibility: Non-EU fee payers with an offer; business, engineering, natural sciences and computer science are excluded, as are students from China.

How to apply: Rolling, with regional deadlines (Africa around 1 May, most other regions mid-June).

title: UCD Global Excellence Scholarship
description:
UCD’s main international scholarship, covering half or all of tuition.

  • 50% or 100% tuition scholarship (graduate taught)

Eligibility: International applicants with an offer for an eligible UCD programme.

How to apply: The 2027/28 round opens in November 2026; last year South Asia, Africa and Pakistan closed on 28 February.

title: University of Galway Science and Engineering Global Scholarships
description:
Merit scholarships for every successful international applicant to science and engineering master’s at Galway.

  • EUR 2,000-5,000 merit award per year
  • Three Excellence awards of EUR 10,000 per programme

Eligibility: International applicants to College of Science and Engineering taught master’s.

How to apply: Check the official page for the 2027 round.

title: Aarhus University Tuition Fee Waivers
description:
Tuition waivers, sometimes with a monthly grant, for highly talented non-EU master’s students.

  • Full tuition waiver
  • Monthly scholarship in some faculties (up to 23 months)

Eligibility: Non-EU/EEA applicants to Aarhus master’s programmes.

How to apply: Apply for admission by 15 January 2027 (summer admission) to be considered.

title: DTU Tuition Fee Waivers for Non-EU MSc Students
description:
A small number of two-year tuition waivers for excellent non-EU MSc students at DTU.

  • Full tuition for two years

Eligibility: New non-EU/EEA MSc applicants for the autumn intake; grades and university ranking are key.

How to apply: Include a separate waiver statement with your application by 15 January 2027.

title: Tampere University Admission Scholarship
description:
Selective 50% tuition scholarships for international master’s students at Tampere University.

  • 50% of tuition (fee EUR 12,000) for the programme duration
  • Early bird offer available

Eligibility: Fee-paying non-EU/EEA applicants. Full-tuition scholarships are no longer offered under Finland’s 2026 rules.

How to apply: Awarded through the January master’s application round.

title: LUT University Early Bird Discount and Second-Year Scholarship
description:
Tuition discounts for non-EU master’s students at LUT University.

  • EUR 5,000 early bird discount in year one (fee EUR 15,000)
  • EUR 5,000 second-year scholarship for completing 60 ECTS

Eligibility: Fee-paying non-EU/EEA students.

How to apply: Pay the discounted first-year fee within 21 days of admission.

title: University of Turku Tuition Discounts
description:
Early bird discount and second-year scholarships for fee-paying international master’s students.

  • EUR 2,000 early bird discount on the first-year fee
  • 50% second-year scholarship if criteria are met

Eligibility: Fee-paying non-EU/EEA students admitted from 2026.

How to apply: Admission scholarships for the first year no longer exist under Finland’s 2026 rules.

title: University of Lausanne Master’s Scholarship
description:
About ten excellence scholarships a year for graduates of foreign universities to take a master’s at UNIL.

  • CHF 1,600 per month for the standard length of the master’s
  • Guaranteed student housing

Eligibility: Graduates of foreign universities with very high academic results.

How to apply: Deadline: 1 November (postmark).

title: Stockholm University Scholarship Scheme
description:
Tuition scholarships for fee-paying non-EU master’s students at Stockholm University.

  • Covers tuition fees (not living costs)

Eligibility: Non-EU/EEA citizens required to pay tuition and admitted in the first international round.

How to apply: In 2026 the scholarship deadline was 30 March, with results in late April.

title: Jönköping University Scholarship
description:
Merit scholarships for fee-paying international students on on-site programmes at Jönköping University.

  • 10% to 30% of tuition
  • Extra partner awards for some countries

Eligibility: Citizens of fee-paying countries applying to an on-site bachelor’s or master’s.

How to apply: For autumn 2027, apply between 16 October 2026 and 2 May 2027.

title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars at the University of Cape Town
description:
Comprehensive scholarships for African students at Africa’s top-ranked university.

  • Tuition
  • Laptop
  • Campus accommodation
  • Living expenses and medical aid
  • Annual travel

Eligibility: African citizens (including South Africans) with an offer from UCT; financial need and leadership potential.

How to apply: Postgraduate (honours/master’s) deadline 31 October 2026; undergraduate closed 30 September.

title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars at Makerere University
description:
Hundreds of undergraduate and master’s scholarships a year at Makerere University in Kampala.

  • Full scholarship
  • Mentoring and leadership support

Eligibility: Undergraduates aged 28 or under (32 for refugees and youth with disabilities); master’s applicants aged 35 or under with an African undergraduate degree.

How to apply: The 2026 deadline was 5 June; expect a similar date in 2027. Applying is free.

title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars at the University of Edinburgh
description:
Full scholarships for young Africans committed to tackling the climate crisis, for one-year on-campus or online master’s.

  • Full tuition
  • Living costs
  • Travel
  • Leadership development

Eligibility: Citizens or refugees resident in Africa, aged 35 or under, with climate-related impact or ambition.

How to apply: Main application deadline 19 November 2026 at 5pm UK time (after the October declaration form).

title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars at KNUST
provider: Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology
description:
Full undergraduate scholarships at KNUST for academically talented young people facing economic hardship.

  • Full tuition
  • Campus accommodation
  • Learning materials and transport
  • Monthly stipend

Eligibility: Applicants with recent WASSCE or equivalent results who meet KNUST admission requirements; priority for women, displaced persons and persons with disabilities.

How to apply: Applications are currently closed; the last call closed 30 June.

title: AIMS Master’s in Mathematical Sciences
description:
Fully funded master’s at AIMS centres across Africa, including Rwanda, Ghana, Senegal, Cameroon and South Africa.

  • Tuition
  • Study materials
  • Housing and meals

Eligibility: African graduates with a four-year degree in mathematics, science or engineering with strong maths.

How to apply: Applications usually open 1 December and close 31 March; there is no application fee.

title: Canon Collins RMTF Scholarships for Postgraduate Study
description:
Scholarships for students from southern Africa to take master’s or PhD study at South African universities.

  • ZAR 20,000 to ZAR 100,000
  • Up to two years (possible third)

Eligibility: Nationals of Angola, Botswana, Eswatini, Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambique, Namibia, South Africa, Zambia and Zimbabwe; 2027 fields are justice, education and humanities.

How to apply: Recent rounds have run from about June to August.

title: DAAD In-Country/In-Region Scholarships for Sub-Saharan Africa
description:
DAAD scholarships for development-related master’s and PhD study at selected universities across Sub-Saharan Africa.

  • Monthly stipend
  • Tuition and study costs
  • Research allowance

Eligibility: Nationals of Sub-Saharan African countries with at least a second-class upper degree obtained within the last six years.

How to apply: Each host university publishes its own call; for example Malawi’s MUBAS call closes 12 November 2026.

title: Waterloo International Doctoral Student Award
description:
An automatic award for every full-time international PhD student at Waterloo, offsetting the international tuition difference.

  • About CAD 15,420 a year for four years
  • Added on top of minimum funding

Eligibility: All full-time international doctoral students.

How to apply: No application; apply to a Waterloo PhD by your programme’s deadline.

title: Waterloo International Master’s Award of Excellence
description:
An award for international research master’s students at Waterloo, nominated by their faculty.

  • CAD 2,500 per term for up to 5 terms

Eligibility: International students in research-based master’s programmes.

How to apply: No separate application.

title: uOttawa Differential Tuition Fee Exemption Scholarship
description:
Large tuition reductions for international students studying in French at the University of Ottawa.

  • Reduces international tuition substantially (e.g. about CAD 12,500 per term for arts undergraduates)
  • Renewable

Eligibility: International students in French-taught programmes or the French Immersion Stream, taking enough courses in French.

How to apply: Awarded automatically on enrolment.

title: Carleton University International Entrance Scholarships
description:
Renewable entrance scholarships and welcome awards for international undergraduates at Carleton.

  • CAD 1,000-3,000 per year renewable (85%+ average)
  • President’s Welcome Award CAD 2,000-5,000
  • Prestige Scholarships up to about CAD 14,000 per year

Eligibility: International high school students entering in the fall.

How to apply: Prestige Scholarships require an application by 1 March 2027; others are automatic.

title: Edinburgh Doctoral College Scholarships
description:
Fully funded PhD scholarships across the University of Edinburgh, open to international students.

  • Full tuition
  • UKRI-rate stipend (GBP 21,805 in 2026-27)
  • 3 to 4 years

Eligibility: PhD applicants to participating schools.

How to apply: Most schools close 2 February 2027; Biological Sciences 16 November and Informatics 30 November 2026.

title: Edinburgh India Merit Scholarship
description:
Scholarships for academically gifted students from India starting a taught master’s at Edinburgh.

  • GBP 5,000 towards tuition

Eligibility: Indian applicants with an offer for a postgraduate taught programme.

How to apply: Recent deadline around 30 April.

title: Bath Global Excellence Scholarship
description:
Up to 250 tuition scholarships for international students on full-time taught master’s at Bath.

  • GBP 10,000 tuition fee waiver

Eligibility: International applicants with an offer for an eligible full-time taught master’s.

How to apply: Faculty scholarship rounds close 4 February, 8 April and 11 June 2027.

title: Bath GREAT Scholarships (Kenya and others)
description:
British Council GREAT awards at Bath for students from Kenya, Germany, Malaysia and Vietnam.

  • GBP 10,000 towards tuition

Eligibility: Passport holders and residents of the eligible countries with international fee status.

How to apply: Applications open in December 2026 and close 8 April 2027.

title: Surrey International Excellence Award
description:
Tuition awards for self-funded international students starting a full-time master’s at Surrey.

  • GBP 5,000 tuition fee reduction

Eligibility: Self-funded international applicants for September 2027; some courses excluded.

How to apply: Check the official page for the closing date.

title: Kent International Scholarship (Masters)
description:
Automatic tuition scholarships for international students who accept an offer for a taught master’s at Kent.

  • Up to GBP 5,000 for the first year (GBP 3,000 at Kent Business School)

Eligibility: International students from eligible countries accepting an offer for a taught master’s.

How to apply: No application needed; 2027 details are confirmed by the university each year.

title: Essex Global Talent Masters Scholarship
description:
An automatic tuition discount for self-funded international master’s students at Essex.

  • GBP 5,000 tuition fee discount

Eligibility: Self-funded international students; eligible applicants are considered automatically.

How to apply: No application form.

title: HKUST RedBird PhD Award and Postgraduate Studentship
provider: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
description:
Funding for international research students at HKUST, combining a studentship with a recruitment award.

  • Postgraduate Studentship HKD 229,620 a year (2026/27)
  • RedBird award HKD 40,000 plus first-year tuition waiver
  • HKD 20,000 a year renewal award

Eligibility: International PhD (and MPhil) applicants admitted to HKUST.

How to apply: Apply by the main round around 1 December 2026 (also considered for the Hong Kong PhD Fellowship).

title: PolyU Entry Scholarship for Non-Local Students
description:
Renewable full-tuition scholarships for top non-local undergraduates with IB or A-Level results.

  • Renewable full tuition
  • Annual allowance up to HKD 70,000
  • One-off HKD 30,000 exchange scholarship

Eligibility: Non-local applicants with excellent IB, GCE A-Level or International A-Level results.

How to apply: Considered automatically with admission.

title: CityUHK Entrance Scholarship for International Students
description:
Merit entrance scholarships for international undergraduates at City University of Hong Kong.

  • Top award HKD 210,000 a year (tuition, housing and living)
  • Full- and half-tuition awards
  • Diversity Grant HKD 30,000 a year for under-represented nationalities

Eligibility: International undergraduate entrants; renewal requires a CGPA of 3.2.

How to apply: Awarded automatically on merit.

title: NTU Taiwan International Outstanding Graduate Student Scholarship
description:
Scholarships for outstanding international graduate students at Taiwan’s top university.

  • Tuition waived up to NTD 100,000
  • NTD 8,000 per month (master’s) or NTD 10,000-15,000 (PhD)

Eligibility: International master’s students below year 2 and PhD students below year 4.

How to apply: The 2026 window was 23 April to 15 May.

title: NTHU International Student Scholarship
description:
Stipends and tuition waivers for international degree students at National Tsing Hua University.

  • Type A: monthly stipend (PhD NTD 20,000-40,000) plus tuition waiver
  • Type B: tuition waiver

Eligibility: International degree applicants, with priority for master’s and doctoral programmes; renewed yearly on merit.

How to apply: Apply together with your NTHU admission application.
